name: {🔴LIVE} Start Your Streamer Career!
desc:
🎥 START YOUR STREAMER CAREER!

👍 THUMBS UP (LIKE) the game for FREE ROLLS!
⭐ Favorite + join the community for more FREE REWARDS!

From a kid with a webcam to a household name... every choice is yours!

- 🎮 Build your streamer, pick your platform and your niche, then live it year after year: going live, viral clips, drama, sponsors, burnout, collabs, the whole streamer life.
- 🍀 Roll for Luck before every career. Rare rolls change everything.
- ⚡ Decisive moments - clutch the game, win the chat, work the convention floor. Chat wants more? Run it back, harder.
- 📺 Stream on Twitch, Kick, YouTube or TikTok. Switch platforms mid-career... if you dare.
- 🏆 Win Creator of the Year, chase the World Creator Games, set your peak-viewer record, climb the world leaderboard.
- 📈 Overall goes from 0 to ???. Almost nobody gets past 100....
- 🔁 Retire, earn skill points, beat your own records, go again.
- 🎉 Weekend events pay DOUBLE rolls on every challenge!
